caption: The drawing features a composition with a central cluster of stylized blue flowers and leaves, painted in varying shades of blue on a beige background. The floral cluster consists of three prominent blossoms with rounded petals and elongated, curved leaves, with the two leftmost flowers displaying pronounced veining and subtle shading. To the upper left of the floral composition, there is a line drawing of a jar with handles on both sides. The jar contains a simplified depiction of flowers and leaves, similar to the main motif, and has a label area and the number "5" marked near the neck. In the lower right corner, there is another line drawing of a crock or vessel, also with handles, an oval label reading “J. FISHER & CO. LYONS N.Y.”, and the number "5" written beside the handle. The background is lightly textured and mottled with brownish speckles scattered throughout, and the entire composition is framed by a wide, light beige border.
title: Churn
